sentences.en: The meaning of words can change according to their context.
sentences.zh: 单词的意思会根据其上下文而改变。

sentences.en: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
sentences.zh: 从上下文中理解一个词的意义。

sentences.en: When you quote a stupid text, do not forget the context.
sentences.zh: 引用愚蠢的文字时，别忘了它的背景。

senses.zh: 上下文；语境；背景；环境；前后关系

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+text（编织）→共同编织在一起的→上下文
